title: monograph-writing: Academic Monograph Batch-Writing Assistant
description: A batch-writing pipeline for academic monographs, textbooks, technical books, and theses, packaged as an Agent Skill for AI writing assistants. Features a disk-persisted progress ledger, an academic red-line system (no fabricated references; contribution classification with dataset freezing and drift tracking), thesis-mode tooling (innovation-point registers, blind-review anonymization), data-bound figure generation, and automated validation scripts.
